answer.reason: The frozen obligation concerns printing an array returned by this harness’s parser. The new array print guard rejects at the same pre-increment nesting threshold as array and object parsing. Parsing and printing both start at depth zero, so a parser-accepted array cannot reach that guard at a rejected depth. The same old harness is used for the before and after assessment.

scope_contract.reason: Printing parser-produced arrays belongs to the target: it parses input and passes a successful result to one of its print calls.

feasible_trigger.reason: There is no finite accepted input that makes a parser-produced array enter the new depth guard at or above the limit. Both container parsers reject at that depth before incrementing it; both print paths begin at zero.

observable_consequence.reason: The claimed depth-only print failure cannot occur for an array accepted by this parser. The harness also has no existing check requiring a non-NULL print result.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: Natural valid JSON inputs already provide the route: the target prints the returned tree through buffered or unbuffered calls, and neither route reaches the new array guard at a parser-accepted depth. This addresses the candidate’s parser-limit counterevidence.

identity_preserved.reason: The before and after comparison uses the same tuple: printing an array returned by the parser at a depth that parser accepts. The old printer has no depth guard; the new one adds a guard that such an array cannot reach.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Print a parser-produced array at a nesting depth accepted by parsing.
coverage_witness.required_setup: A parser-produced array at an accepted depth; reaching the new rejection would require a depth the parser rejects.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The harness prints only a non-NULL result from cJSON_ParseWithOpts, using buffered or unbuffered printing.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: None established: the new depth guard cannot reject an array at a parser-accepted depth.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: Valid array JSON reaches the existing buffered or unbuffered print path at every parser-accepted container depth.
